renderedGroups.text: Now turn to section two on page four.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Section two.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: You will hear the manager of a new sports center

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: talking to potential customers about the facilities there.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: First you have some time to look at questions 11 to 16 on page 4.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 16.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Good evening and welcome to Karrara's brand new Sports and Leisure Centre.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: First I'll tell you about our facilities, then feel free to wander around the centre.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Now as you can see from the map I've given you,

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: We're sitting in our cafe, which we hope will be a favorite place to visit after exercising.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: To one side of us, and right in front of you as you enter the complex, is the shop.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Be sure to have a look in there later as we've got some great opening specials on footwear.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: On the other side of the cafe, and ideally situated between the cafe and the childminding

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: facilities, we have the playground. You can sit and relax there while your kids have a

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: great time on the equipment. And our childcare facilities are available to anyone using the

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: centre. Let's talk a little bit about our heated swimming pool, which is also near

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: the entrance, on the other side from the cafe. It has a 5 metre water slide, which

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: will be very popular with kids of all ages, and in the corner nearest the changing rooms

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: we have a hi-tech hot spa. The water is heated to 38 degrees centigrade which is

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: the ideal temperature to relax tired muscles after a workout. So where can you

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: do these workouts? Well we have a large weights room located at the cafe end of

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: the administration block. In the weights room you'll find all the latest

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: equipment. We also have trainers there who can put a program together for you.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Another place to get a good workout is in the gym, which is shown on the map to the right of the changing rooms.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: There will be all sorts of classes offered there.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Our aim is to provide all your exercise and recovery needs.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: So, as well as the spa to help aching bodies, we also have a special area for massage.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: It's in the funny-shaped room close to the administration area.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Its distinctive shape has already led to the nickname of the Bullet Room.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: We'll be offering Swedish and Chinese massage there, and we'll offer physiotherapy in the future.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions 17 to 20 on page 5.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
renderedGroups.text: Now listen and answer questions 17 to 20.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Now, let me tell you something about our different memberships.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: Firstly, we offer different types of membership to cater for different needs. If you are a

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: fitness freak, then choose our all-in membership. This gives you access to everything in the

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: centre, all the classes and sports. It's usually our most expensive option, but for

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: a short time, we're offering 12 months for the price of 9, which is a huge saving.

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: If you prefer just the gym classes you may want to consider the gym and weights

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: package. It works out at $10 a week which is good value. If you just want to swim

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: then we recommend getting a swim plus membership. With this you have unlimited

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: use of the pool and spa. The other package we've reduced for this month

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: only is the off-peak. This is aimed at people who are happy to come at less

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: busy times. And finally, we have the family pack. We believe in keeping the whole family

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: fit and healthy, so this package works out cheaper than buying it separately. Your flyer

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: has details of all the prices. So, anyone who signs up for a new membership

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: tonight will receive two fantastic presents from us. We wanted to make these rewards

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: something different from the norm. We could have just chosen a towel for you

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: to use in the gym or some clothing from the shop, but we wanted to show our

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: appreciation by giving you something special. So not only are we going to

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: give you a voucher for a session in our massage centre, a great way to unwind

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: after your workout, but you'll also get this great device that measures your

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: heart rate. And finally, just for turning up tonight, we'd like to give everyone here

renderedGroups.speaker: Centre manager
renderedGroups.text: a drink bottle to take away with them. That's all I wanted to say.

renderedGroups.speaker: Narrator
